summary: Architecture analysis for Kieran Flanagan skill design. Examines existing patterns (Luke Iha = 8 skills, Cardinal Mason = 1, Dan Koe = 2), tests all 15 workflows for independence, and recommends 3-skill hybrid: audience-intelligence (4 workflows), content-engine (8 workflows), content-ops (3 workflows). Includes evidence table, token efficiency comparison, and routing impact analysis.
